About this item

  • 【19,000Pa Powerful Suction】 Featuring ultra-strong 19,000Pa suction, this robot vacuum and mop easily handles both fine dust and large debris. From scattered oatmeal and pet food to deeply embedded hair and dust, it delivers thorough cleaning on hard floors and carpets alike.
  • 【Dual Smart Brushes】 Designed for different messes, the liftable rubber brush captures large debris from floor gaps and carpets, while the TriCut brush cuts long hair to prevent tangling—ideal for homes with pets and long hair.
  • 【Edge Reach Cleaning】 MopExtend technology expands the mopping pad to clean along edges and under furniture. Combined with AI-powered 3D obstacle avoidance, it accurately recognizes and avoids over 120 types of objects such as cables, socks, and shoes.
  • 【All-in-One PowerDock】 The self-emptying PowerDock Base enables up to 100 days of hands-free maintenance. It automatically empties dust, washes mops with 149℉ hot water, and dries them with hot air for a hygienic, odor-free finish after every clean.
  • 【Pet-Friendly Smart Control】 Custom carpet modes include suction boost, mop lifting up to 10.5mm, and zone avoidance. Built for pet owners, it detects pet-related objects and supports real-time video calls and two-way voice interaction for added peace of mind. Supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi only.

    • UDAYKIRAN KOGANTI
      5 out of 5 stars
      Best robo I have bought
      Reviewed in India on 6 May 2026
      Set name: L40 Ultra AE
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The Dreame L40 Ultra AE is one of the most feature-packed robot vacuum and mop combos currently available in India, especially for users who want a near hands-free cleaning experience. It combines strong suction power, intelligent navigation, advanced mopping, and a highly automated dock system that significantly reduces manual work.

      What immediately stands out is its excellent cleaning performance on hard floors. Dust, hair, and daily debris are handled very effectively, while the dual rotating mop system does a surprisingly good job with dried stains and sticky patches. The automatic mop washing and hot-air drying system make everyday maintenance much easier compared to basic robot vacuums.

      Navigation is another strong point. The LiDAR mapping and AI obstacle avoidance work very well in real homes, helping the robot avoid furniture, slippers, charging cables, and pet bowls more accurately than many mid-range competitors. Reviewers have especially praised the AE version for its improved obstacle avoidance and efficient path planning.

      The fully automated dock is a major convenience feature. It can:

      • Empty the dustbin automatically

      • Wash mop pads with hot water

      • Dry the pads with hot air

      • Refill clean water automatically

      • Clean the washing tray itself

      For busy households, especially in Indian homes where dust accumulation is frequent, this reduces daily cleaning effort dramatically.

      The Dreame app is also feature-rich, offering:

      • Multi-floor mapping

      • Room-wise cleaning

      • No-go zones

      • Carpet detection

      • Custom suction and water settings

      • Scheduled cleaning

      However, the L40 Ultra AE is not perfect.

      The dock is physically large and requires dedicated space near a power outlet. Some users also mention that occasional maintenance is still necessary, especially cleaning the tray area and sensors. Like most robot vacuums, it can still struggle with loose cables and very cluttered floors.

      On carpets, performance is good but not class-leading for deep cleaning. It works best as a maintenance cleaner rather than a replacement for a powerful manual vacuum cleaner.

      Overall Rating: 9/10

      Pros:

      • Powerful suction and excellent mopping

      • Very good obstacle avoidance

      • Fully automated dock system

      • Strong app customization

      • Great for daily maintenance cleaning

      • Ideal for pet hair and dust control

      Cons:

      • Expensive initial cost

      • Large docking station

      • Still needs occasional manual maintenance

      • Deep carpet cleaning could be better

      . Can't able to delete room in maps

      Final Verdict:

      The Dreame L40 Ultra AE is worth buying if you want a premium robotic cleaning solution with minimal daily effort. It is especially suitable for medium to large homes with hard flooring, pets, or busy lifestyles. For users upgrading from basic robot vacuums, the automation and convenience feel like a major leap forward.

    • Amazon Customer
      5 out of 5 stars
      L'aspirateur robot à un autre niveau
      Reviewed in France on 4 March 2023
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Cela fait une dizaine d'années que j'utilise ces robots, des premiers Neato, aux iRobot, puis après des années de bons et loyaux services je suis passé au Roborock s7 car la fonction lavage me manquait vraiment et j'ai été vraiment satisfait.

      Je viens, pour ma résidence principale, de passer au Dreame L10 Ultra, après avoir visionné tout ce que j'ai pu trouver sur internet et YouTube.

      Aucun regret, et surtout une vraie satisfaction d'avoir du matériel vraiment efficace. L'appli est excellente, la qualité d'aspiration sur le carrelage et les tapis est sans faute, et le lavage est vraiment excellent.

      On vide le réservoir d'eau sale dans les toilettes et on rempli le réservoir d'eau claire et c'est tout.

      La station change la vie par sa simplicité. Le lavage et le séchage des serpillères est une fonction formidable, car sur le S7 de Roborock pour avoir laissé la serpillère sur le robot pendant 3 jours car je ne suis pas repassé à la maison, les odeurs de moisi étaient particulièrement désagréables.

      La navigation est excellente probablement encore meilleure que le roborock s7, le prix du L10s Ultra avec son IA additionnelle ne se justifie pas chez moi. C'est rangé et il n'y a pas grand chose qui traine par terre.

      En mode intensif (plus d'eau et plus de chevauchement des passages de la serpillère) les résultats sont impeccables. C'est propre et le lavage combiné à l'aspiration réduit visiblement les poussières sur les meubles dans la maison, bon ce n'est pas trop scientifique mais c'est mon observation.

      Silencieux, c'est le jour et la nuit par rapport à un iRobot 960, et un peu plus silencieux que le Roborock.

      Je ne suis pas un habitué de la publication de commentaires produits, mais là je pense que c'est un appareil qui change la vie en permettant de rentrer chez soi avec une maison impeccable.

      J'espère que ce petit texte vous aidera dans vos recherches du modèle idéal.

    • anwi
      5 out of 5 stars
      Fleißiges, tolles Helferlein, vor allem bei Hundehaaren
      Reviewed in Germany on 22 September 2023
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Der Dreame ist jetzt knapp drei Wochen im Einsatz und ich bin total begeistert.

      Saugt wirklich sehr gut, feudelt ordentlich feucht durch. Mahnt zum aufräumen. Vorgestern lag ein Lappen im Flur, der in den Keller sollte. Hat Helene schön angesaugt, dadurch ihre Sensoren verdeckt und ist (zum Glück nur eine Stufe) die Treppe runter. Uuups! Nix passiert, aber man darf einfach nix liegen lassen.

      Die Bedienung über die App funktioniert super. Ich fand sie sehr einfach zu verstehen und bedienen.

      Die Saugkraft und die Wischfeuchte ebenso wie die Anzahl der Reinigungsdurchgänge lassen sich individuell auf Raum und Bodenbelag anpassen. Bei der qm Größe, nach wievielen gewischten qm der Wischer zurück zur Station fährt, um die Wischer zu reinigen und neu zu befeuchten, würde ich die Einstellung auf werksmäßig eingestellten 10 qm belassen, sonst wird es zwischendurch schon recht trocken an den Wischern.

      Die Teppicherkennung funktioniert einwandfrei, da heben sich automatisch die Wischer an.

      Es lassen sich Shortcuts einrichten, mit denen man festlegen kann, was wie gereinigt werden soll, wenn man den Shortcut aktiviert. Auch Reinigungsroutinen lassen sich einfach einstellen. So saugt Dreame hier jeden Tag einmal komplett die Etage durch und einmal pro Woche wird gewischt.

      Sollte das nicht reichen, lassen sich die Räume auch separat ansteuern, ebenso wie einzelne Zonen, die gereinigt werden sollen.

      Die Station ist recht groß, fällt aber neben dem großen Schrank nicht so auf.

      Das Problem, von dem hier schon mehrfach berichtet wurde, hatte ich auch - es wurde zunächst kein Wasser vom Tank zum Gerät gepumpt. Mit einem stabilen Strohhalm und ein paar Mal kräftig ansaugen, ließ sich das Problem schnell beheben.

      Fazit : Ein super Helfer im Haushalt, auch auf mehreren Etagen. Saugen schafft er bis zum Rand, beim Wischen bleibt ein schmaler Rand trocken. Hat man aber schnell mal mit einem Lappen erledigt.

      Ich möchte diesen Helfer in dem Haus mit dem haarenden Hund nicht mehr missen.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Mai più senza
      Reviewed in Italy on 2 February 2024
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Ero molto scettico nell'acquistare un robot aspirapolvere e lava pavimenti. Pensavo che non fossero in grado di pulire bene e che mi sarebbe toccato lavare non solo casa ma anche lui.

      In realtà mi sono ricreduto dopo il primo utilizzo.

      Aspira e lava alla grande. Anche se le condizioni del vostro pavimento sono critiche lui si comporta alla grande. Le caratteristiche che mi piacciono:

      1. Mappatura: Mappa la vostra casa in maniera impeccabile.

      2. Non urta i mobili: una delle paure che io e mia moglie avevamo era che potesse sbattere e rovinare i mobili. In realtà si avvicina tantissimo ma non li tocca, non so come sia capace. Ha una precisione nel muoversii tra gli ostacoli che sbalordisce.

      3. App: facile da usare ed essenziale. Vi fa gestire in maniera molto intuitiva quale stanza pulire, con che potenza di aspirazione, con che livello di umidità dei moci e quante volte passare.

      4. Moci: fanno la differenza nel lavaggio. Ho qualche amico che possiede modelli con il sistema di lavaggio a vibrazioni del mocio, vi garantisco che non c'è paragone. I moci rotanti lavano il sistema vibrante getta solo acqua.

      5. Stazione: se dovete acquistare un robot del genere acquistatelo con una stazione che aspiri la polvere in autonomia e che faccia il ricambio dell'acqua come questo. Non pensate proprio di fare altra scelta.

      In conclusione vi straconsiglio questo robot. Io non ne posso più fare a meno.

    About this Item

    • 【19,000Pa Powerful Suction】 Featuring ultra-strong 19,000Pa suction, this robot vacuum and mop easily handles both fine dust and large debris. From scattered oatmeal and pet food to deeply embedded hair and dust, it delivers thorough cleaning on hard floors and carpets alike.
    • 【Dual Smart Brushes】 Designed for different messes, the liftable rubber brush captures large debris from floor gaps and carpets, while the TriCut brush cuts long hair to prevent tangling—ideal for homes with pets and long hair.
    • 【Edge Reach Cleaning】 MopExtend technology expands the mopping pad to clean along edges and under furniture. Combined with AI-powered 3D obstacle avoidance, it accurately recognizes and avoids over 120 types of objects such as cables, socks, and shoes.
    • 【All-in-One PowerDock】 The self-emptying PowerDock Base enables up to 100 days of hands-free maintenance. It automatically empties dust, washes mops with 149℉ hot water, and dries them with hot air for a hygienic, odor-free finish after every clean.
    • 【Pet-Friendly Smart Control】 Custom carpet modes include suction boost, mop lifting up to 10.5mm, and zone avoidance. Built for pet owners, it detects pet-related objects and supports real-time video calls and two-way voice interaction for added peace of mind. Supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi only.
